extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and recipients; institutional research administrators; program officers and NIH/HHS staff involved in grant administration
extracted.subtask_description: A comprehensive table-of-contents for the NIH Grants Policy Statement (10/98) describing the standards, requirements, and administrative procedures that govern NIH grants and cooperative agreements. Useful for applicants, grantees, and institutional administrators to ensure eligibility, allowable costs, required approvals, reporting, human subjects and animal protections, intellectual property, and closeout procedures comply with NIH policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roles and Responsibilities (NIH/HHS and Grantee Staff)
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines the roles and responsibilities of NIH/HHS staff and grantee staff in the grants process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC indicates separate subsections for NIH and HHS staff and for grantee staff; details are in the full text about who does what during application, award, administration, monitoring, and closeout.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application and Review Processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural rules and standards governing submission, peer review, council review, and disposition of applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists Support Mechanisms, Eligibility, Types of Applications, Application Submission, Forms, Receipt Points and Deadlines, Legal implications, Confidentiality, Initial Review, National Advisory Council or Board Review, Appeals, and Disposition of Applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification and eligibility rules for different application types (e.g., competing, noncompeting, renewal, supplemental).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Types of Applications' and associated requirements; detailed eligibility and application-specific rules appear in the full sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on advertised funding opportunities and how they relate to application submission and eligibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC indicates a section describing mechanisms and announcements (e.g., Program Announcements, RFAs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Submission (Forms and Procedures)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for submitting applications, including required forms and the table of required forms for competing applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC references 'Application Forms' and 'Table 1: Required Forms for Competing Applications' as well as receipt points and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receipt Points and Deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for where and when applications must be received to be considered timely and accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Application Receipt Points and Deadlines'—details would include submission windows, late application policy, and processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal Implication of Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal considerations and consequences associated with submitting an application to NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes this heading; full text likely covers certifications, representations, and binding statements by applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Information (Proprietary Information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing confidentiality and treatment of proprietary or sensitive information included in applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC identifies confidentiality as a distinct topic; full guidance would explain what is considered proprietary and how NIH handles such material.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Peer Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and procedures for scientific peer review, including initial review, council/board review, and appeals of review outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'The Peer Review Process', 'Initial Review', 'National Advisory Council or Board Review', and 'Appeals of Initial Scientific Review' — specifics on criteria, scoring, and conflict-of-interest rules are in the full text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles that guide NIH funding decisions and distribution of award funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part II TOC references 'Funding Principles'—the full section spells out priorities, paylines, and considerations (e.g., scientific merit, program balance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility (for Awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility rules for applicants and types of institutions that may receive NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility appears multiple places (general eligibility and specific program eligibility). The full text includes criteria for institutions, individuals, foreign institutions, for-profit entities, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Analysis and Assessment of Management Systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for evaluating applicant financial systems and cost proposals prior to award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC references 'Cost Analysis and Assessment of Management Systems'; full guidance covers how NIH assesses allowability of costs and the adequacy of grantee financial management systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Policy Requirements and Objectives (umbrella)
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH-mandated public policy requirements that grantees must follow as conditions of award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an umbrella heading; the TOC enumerates many specific public policies (see subsequent entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethical and Safe Conduct in Science and Organizational Operations
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations for ethical conduct, safety practices, and organizational policies to ensure responsible research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes this heading; full text would address institutional responsibilities, training, and compliance expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to identify and manage financial and other conflicts of interest affecting research integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Conflict of Interest' as a public policy requirement; details in full policy govern disclosure and management plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debarment and Suspension
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions on awarding grants to individuals or organizations that are debarred or suspended from federal programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists this requirement; full guidance includes vetting procedures and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drug-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that grantee organizations maintain a drug-free workplace as a condition of federal funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC indicates this policy; further details include required certifications and consequences for violations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Health and Safety Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards to ensure health and safety in research and organizational operations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists health and safety guidelines; full text would reference OSHA, biosafety, and institutional safety programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on Use of Funds for Promotion or Legalization of Controlled Substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Restrictions preventing use of grant funds for activities promoting or legalizing controlled substances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes this specific limitation under public policy requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibitions and disclosure requirements regarding lobbying activities using grant funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Lobbying'; full guidance addresses allowable communications and required disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Misconduct in Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies addressing allegations and procedures related to research misconduct (fabrication, falsification, plagiarism).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Misconduct in Science'; full policy explains reporting, investigation, and sanctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nondelinquency on Federal Debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that grantees not be delinquent on federal debt as a condition of receiving awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists this requirement under public policy objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recombinant DNA and Institutional Biosafety Committees
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and oversight for recombinant DNA research and institutional biosafety committee (IBC) responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists this subject; full section details compliance with NIH guidelines for recombinant DNA work and IBC approvals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Restriction on Distribution of Sterile Needles
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy restricting use of funds for distribution of sterile needles in certain contexts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC identifies this specific public policy restriction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seat Belt Use; Smoke-Free Workplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Public-safety-related policies (promotion of seat belt use and smoke-free workplaces) as NIH expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists these as public policy requirements or objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements Affecting Rights and Welfare of Research Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Protections and requirements to safeguard rights, welfare, privacy, and confidentiality of research subjects, patients, or service recipients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This umbrella includes human subjects protections, confidentiality, IND requirements, Pro-Children Act, protection of subjects' identity, transplantation of fetal tissue, animal welfare, and inclusion policies (see entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ban on Human Embryo Research and Cloning
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy prohibiting certain human embryo research and cloning activities using NIH funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Ban and Human Embryo Research and Cloning' as a public policy topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidentiality of Patient Records
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to maintain and protect the confidentiality of patient records used in research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes this item; full guidance covers HIPAA and other privacy-related obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects Protections
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for human subjects research, including review, consent, and protections against risks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Human Subjects' and related topics such as IND applications and protection of identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investigational New Drug (IND) Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements related to investigational new drug submissions and the use of INDs in NIH-funded research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Investigational New Drug Applications' under public policy requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro-Children Act of 1994
rubrics_metrics.description: Compliance with the Pro-Children Act as it pertains to NIH-funded programs affecting children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists this federal statute among public policy requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Research Subjects' Identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific protections against disclosure of identifiable information about research participants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes this as a distinct concern under human subjects protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research on Transplantation of Fetal Tissue
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies governing NIH-funded research involving transplantation of fetal tissue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists this specific topic among human-subjects-related policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Animal Welfare
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for humane treatment and oversight of vertebrate animals used in NIH-funded research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Animal Welfare' as a public policy requirement; full text covers IACUC, housing, veterinary care, and compliance standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Inclusiveness in Research Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Expectations for inclusion of women, minorities, and children in clinical research and the rationale/requirements for inclusion plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC specifically lists 'Inclusion of Women and Minorities as Subjects in Clinical Research' and 'Inclusion of Children as Subjects in Clinical Research'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil Rights and Anti-Discrimination Statutes
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability of civil rights laws (Age Discrimination Act, Civil Rights Act, Education Amendments, Rehabilitation Act) to NIH-funded programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists these statutes and implies compliance requirements for grantees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental Impact and Construction-Related Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: NEPA and related environmental and construction standards for NIH-assisted facility projects, including historic properties, flood insurance, and public disclosure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists environmental impact and acquisition/alteration/renovation requirements under public policy objectives and Part III construction grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Information; Acknowledgment of Federal Funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for public access to information, acknowledging federal funding, FOIA and Privacy Act obligations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Availability of Information', 'Acknowledgment of Federal Funding', 'The Freedom of Information Act', and 'The Privacy Act'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Public Policy Requirements (Metric System, Military Recruiting Access, Year 2000 Compliance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous federal policy requirements that grantees must observe (use of metric system, campus access for military recruiting/ROTC, Y2K compliance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists these as additional public policy obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Grant Award (NGA) — Funding and Budget Terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Contents and legal effect of the Notice of Grant Award, including funding amount, budget terms, and additional conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC indicates the NGA section and related items like additional terms and conditions and payment mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and Cash Management (SMARTLINK II/ACH; CASHLINE/ACH; Monthly Cash Request)
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment systems, cash advance procedures, monthly cash requests, and interest earned on advances to grantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists specific payment systems and policies governing advances and interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Considerations and Cost Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Principles for allowable costs, direct costs vs. facilities & administrative (indirect) costs, cost transfers, overruns, allocation of costs, and applicable credits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC references 'The Cost Principles', direct and F&A costs, cost transfers, allocation of costs, applicable credits, and selected items of cost; full text contains OMB cost principle references and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs/Activities and Selected Items of Cost
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules determining which costs and activities are allowable or unallowable under NIH grants, and treatment of specific cost categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Allowability of Costs/Activities' and 'Selected Items of Cost'; full guidance provides detailed examples and exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative Requirements (Prior Approval, Changes in Project/Budget)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and thresholds requiring prior approval from NIH for changes in project scope, transfers, rebudgeting, and other approvals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Changes in Project and Budget', 'Prior Approval Requirements', 'Expanded Authorities', and 'Requests for Approval'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Noncompeting Continuation Awards and Streamlined Processes
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies for continuation awards, progress reporting requirements, and any streamlined procedures for noncompeting continuations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC references 'Noncompeting Continuation Awards' and 'Streamlined Noncompeting Award Process'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of Research Results; Rights in Data, Publications, and Unique Research Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies on publication rights, data sharing, unique research resources, copyrights, and public accessibility of results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists rights in data, unique research resources, and publications—full policy defines expectations for data release and resource sharing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents; Invention Reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements governing invention reporting, patent rights, allocation of royalties, and final invention statements and certifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Inventions and Patents' and 'Invention Reporting'; full sections describe Bayh-Dole Act obligations and reporting forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial Management System Standards and Program Income
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards grantees must meet for financial management systems and accounting for program income, sale of property, royalties, and related reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists financial management standards, program income, sale of property, and reporting/royalty rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Property Management System Standards (Real Property, Equipment, Exempt/Nonexempt Property)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for managing, documenting, using, and disposing of real and personal property acquired with grant funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists real property, equipment and supplies, exempt and nonexempt property, and revocable licenses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procurement System Standards and Contracting Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and requirements for procurement, including contracting with small businesses, minority-owned firms, and women-owned enterprises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC references procurement system standards, approval requirements, and monitoring of contractors and subcontractors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring, Reporting, and Recordkeeping (Progress Reports, Financial Reports, Record Retention)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for periodic progress reports, financial reporting, record retention and access, and reporting unobligated balances and expenditures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists progress reports, financial reports, reporting of program income, unobligated balances, and record retention; full guidance includes formats and submission timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reporting to the Office of Research Integrity (ORI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligations to report certain allegations or findings of research misconduct to ORI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Report to the Office of Research Integrity'—details in full policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lobbying Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Required disclosures and reporting related to lobbying activities associated with grant-funded programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Lobbying Disclosure' as a reporting requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit, Enforcement, and Recovery of Funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Audit standards, enforcement actions including suspension/termination/withholding, debt collection, and recovery of funds for noncompliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Audit', 'Enforcement Actions', 'Suspension, Termination, and Withholding of Support', 'Recovery of Funds', and 'Debt Collection'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout and Final Reports (Financial Status, Progress, Final Invention Statement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Closeout procedures and required final reports such as Final Financial Status Report, Final Progress Report, and Final Invention Statement and Certification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists detailed closeout deliverables and the 'Grant Appeals Procedures' for disputes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Construction Grants — Eligibility and Design/Construction Standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements specific to construction grants: eligibility, review and approval, public policy compliance (NEPA), design standards, flood insurance, historic properties, and applicable facility design handbooks and codes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part III TOC enumerates many construction-related standards and referenced industry codes and handbooks (HVAC, plumbing, life safety, laboratory ventilation, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of Costs/Procurement for Construction Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific cost allowability rules and procurement requirements unique to construction and alteration/renovation projects funded by NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes sections on allowable/unallowable costs and procurement requirements for construction services (design-build, construction management).

rubrics_metrics.name: Real Property Management Standards for Construction and Nonconstruction Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for acquisition, management, appraisals, notice of federal interest, insurance, use, and disposition of real property acquired or improved with NIH funds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Real Property Management Standards' and exhibits such as cost estimate outlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: National Research Service Awards (NRSA) — Individual Fellowship Eligibility and Terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing individual NRSAs (fellowships): eligibility, degree requirements for predoctoral/postdoctoral/senior fellows, citizenship/sponsorship, special categories (NIH employees, military), application/receipt dates, review, notification, period of support, initiation of support, and payment procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC contains a detailed NRSA subsection listing many subtopics including stipend levels, supplementation, allowable institutional costs, tuition/fees, travel to foreign sites, reporting procedures, payback agreements, and termination.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Financial Provisions — Stipends and Institutional Allowances
rubrics_metrics.description: Stipend levels for predoc/postdoc/senior fellows, stipend supplementation rules, compensation, benefits, and institutional allowances and allowable costs by institution type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists stipend-level breakdowns and related financial provisions; full details include taxation and Form 1099 treatment.

rubrics_metrics.name: NRSA Reporting Procedures and Payback Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms and procedures for activation notices, payback agreements, termination notices, certification of payback activities, breaks in support, and service/financial payback calculations, waivers, and extensions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC enumerates payback reporting and certification forms (e.g., Form PHS 6031-1) and payback policy subsections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional NRSA (Training Grants) — Eligibility and Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, degree requirements, trainee categories, application/receipt dates, review processes (including minority recruitment plans and responsible conduct training), period of support, financial provisions, and reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists detailed subtopics applying to institutional training grants similar to individual NRSA provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support of Scientific Meetings (Conference Grants)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicability, definitions, eligibility, application procedures, public policy requirements, review, funding rules, allowable costs, administrative requirements, IP/publication considerations, and reporting for conference grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC indicates a specific section governing conference grant awards and required documentation/reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium Agreements and Subaward/Subcontract Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Administrative and contractual requirements for consortium arrangements, subawards, and contractors under NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes 'Consortium Agreements' with general and administrative requirements; full text addresses written agreements, flow-down terms, and oversight responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards to Foreign Institutions and Grants with Substantial Foreign Components
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility, review, public policy compliance, funding/payment, allowability of costs, administrative requirements, changes in project scope, audit, and reporting specific to foreign institutions and international components of grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists a dedicated section on foreign awards and domestic grants with substantial foreign components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to Federal Institutions and Payments to Federal Employees
rubrics_metrics.description: Special eligibility, payment, allowable costs, administrative, and property accounting requirements when federal institutions or federal employees are recipients/participants under grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC includes a section on grants to federal institutions and payments on behalf of federal employees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants to For-Profit Organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies covering eligibility, allowability of costs, cost principles, profit or fee, IR&D independent research and development costs, facilities & administrative costs, program income, and audit for for-profit grantees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC provides a separate set of topics applying to for-profit organizations, including intellectual property rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Program-specific eligibility, public policy requirements, allowability of costs and fee/profit rules, F&A treatment, market research, program income, and IP rights for SBIR/STTR awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC references SBIR/STTR as distinct programs with tailored administrative and cost rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Patient Care Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions, policy, and allowability of costs associated with research patient care and computation of patient care costs for facilities and administrative cost purposes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC lists 'Research Patient Care Costs' including computation and special procedures for certain hospitals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Administrative Topics: Points of Contact and External Documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists points of contact and master list of links to external documents referenced by the NIHGPS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Part IV and appendices provide contact information and references to forms, schedules, and external guidance documents.
